task: Pick up the CUP and place it on the TABLE.
plan_summary: Navigate robot CAR to the CUP location, pick up the CUP, navigate to the TABLE location, and place the CUP on the TABLE.
assumptions: Robot CAR is not holding any object initially
CUP is graspable by robot CAR
Navigating to the CUP coordinates will bring the robot within interaction distance to pick it
Navigating to the TABLE coordinates will bring the robot within interaction distance to place the CUP on it
